HOW TO FINISH SETUP (3 clicks)
1. Webhook node > Credential > Create new "Header Auth". Name: X-Workspace-Secret. Value: the same secret as N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET in your .env.
2. "Get inbox emails" node > Credential > Create new > Sign in with Google.
3. Publish the workflow, open the Webhook node, copy the PRODUCTION URL into N8N_WEBHOOK_URL in your .env.

This workflow only ever answers with emails that match the rules your dashboard sends. It never sends, deletes or changes any email.
